_comment: 5.2 golden baseline for tools/audit_render_probe.py metrics, encoding audit §11 DoD #7-#12. Bounds are the pass criteria; the live regression test renders the probe PDF and asserts every metric falls inside. Regenerate ONLY by re-measuring a known-good render, never by editing to fit a broken one (same rule as test_page_budget).

page_count.note: 7 sections x 4 sheets + 8 front/back matter, as measured by the audit and reproduced arithmetically in test_page_budget

embedded_images.note: 300-DPI charts, one per section; section imagery (DoD #12, >=2000px) is not exercised by the probe payload (section_images=None) and is covered by test_font_embedding/test imagery checks
